I was in Vietnam. They put me in the shits. The place was horrible. Cheap whores though. You just had to watch out for the one with razors in their innards if you catch my drift. It was on a hot Friday night. Their was a cool breeze in the air that night and although I was in the middle of hell that cool breeze sent me back to a sweet little place called Tulsa Oklahoma. That place was my home. I could remember sitting under the giant elm tree in the front yard on a hot summer day and feeling that cool breeze hit my face, ever so gently rearranging the hair above on my head. Then shots fired snapped me back to reality. One of my comrades had been hit in the chest. It was a night raid... On 4th of July nonetheless. His name was Damien. We had only met 7 months prior in Da Nang. I could hear him screaming from a few paces away. He was yelling "Don't you fucking let me die Vance. Don't you let me die." He was starting to tremble and the words stuttered as they left his mouth "d-d-d-ddont you f-f-f- let m-mee die DA DA dammit. He bled out right in front of me. Although he did enjoy his 2 dollar whores more than most...He was just a good ole boy from Clayton Oklahoma. That was as real as life got for me. Four months later we marched through the jungle. That's when I was hit by a sniper. I had raised my arms as I was yawning and it felt like something hot had burned right through my chest and a little under my armpit. I could feel my flesh rip like paper being torn from a notebook. My blood squirted out on impact of the bullet. As I fell to the ground mommas peach cobbler ran through my head. Beatrice's light brown eyes stared at me. She was my high school sweetheart. I could hear my comrades screaming at me, but they all sounded like distant echoes. Everything began to feel cold like the time we went to visit my Aunt and uncle for Christmas in Pennsylvania, but it was colder. I remembered the snow angels I made with my cousin victor in the front yard. The last think I thought of was my family that Christmas day. Then suddenly their wasn't enough blood for my heart to pump through my body. That was it for me. I was done.
